column3: Close to the Hebrew; כַּתַּר־ לִי (“wait for”) is rendered “Bear with me,” and NKJV supplies “to speak on God’s behalf.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “no one” and renders “strength of heart” as “strength of understanding.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּשֶׁלַח (“by the weapon”) is rendered “by the sword.”
Close to the Hebrew; “godless of heart” is rendered “the hypocrites in heart,” and “they set anger” “store up wrath.”
Close to the Hebrew; בַּקְּדֵשִׁים (“among the cult prostitutes”) is rendered “among the perverted persons.”
The Hebrew is difficult (“he has allured you from the mouth of distress”); NKJV renders “He would have brought you out of dire distress.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NKJV renders “lest it entice you in mockery” as “lest He take you away with one blow,” a different reading of the noun.
Close to the Hebrew; “to go up” is rendered “are cut off.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the crashes of his pavilion” is rendered “The thunder from His canopy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the roots of the sea” is rendered “the depths of the sea.”
